source: Persian grade 3, chapter 1 «نهادها», lesson 1 «محله‌ی ما». Card PERSIAN-01 (source docx L10973: Q01, the signs of the important places were moved; the player places each sign by its short description and the clues of the environment; Read → Observe → Match → Place; signs Drag/Snap; wrong = a place that does not fit the text; misconception «one word in common with the place is enough, the whole sentence does not matter»; H1 «به جمله‌ی کامل توجه کن.», H2 key word highlighted, H3 text clue and scene clue side by side; assets PROP_VILLAGE_SIGN, PROP_SCHOOL_SIGN, PROP_MARKET_SIGN, PROP_LIBRARY_SIGN, PROP_WELL, PROP_ROUTE_MARKER; the sign snaps and the place reacts; wood sound, small confirm bell, village ambience; optional audio read; analytics reading_started, sign_inspected, location_selected, wrong_context, hint_used, puzzle_solved; mastery = a NEW text connected to the right place without Highlight; Transfer: find a place in the school from a short description) + FARSI_01 (L738: read the signs and find the right place; skills explicit information, vocabulary, reading comprehension; wrong = choosing the place only from the picture; Transfer: a new text with the same skill). Persian card contract (L10962): short ORIGINAL texts, never long book text; audio help is optional and must not replace reading. Plan 12 §1 row 3.

stages.objective_fa: هر تابلو را بخوان و جلوی جای درستش بگذار.

signs.text_fa: بچه‌ها با صدای زنگ این‌جا می‌آیند و درس می‌خوانند.
signs.tts_fa: بچه‌ها با صدای زنگْ این‌جا می‌آیند و درس می‌خوانند.

signs.text_fa: این‌جا کتاب قرض می‌گیریم و آرام می‌خوانیم.
signs.tts_fa: این‌جا کتابْ قرض می‌گیریم و آرام می‌خوانیم.

signs.text_fa: مردم با سطل از این‌جا آب برمی‌دارند و میوه‌ها را می‌شویند.
signs.tts_fa: مردم با سطلْ از این‌جا آب برمی‌دارند و میوه‌ها را می‌شویند.

hints.animation: LUMI flies under the whole sentence on the reading card, right to left; each word glows in turn (card H1: pay attention to the whole sentence)
the key words of the sentence are highlighted on the reading card (card H2); trap words stay plain
two clues side by side (card H3): the highlighted key words on the card and a round lens with the matching clue of the scene (bell, fruit, books, bucket), joined by a dotted line to that place

stages.objective_fa: نوشته‌ی هر نشانه را بخوان و آن را سرِ راهِ درست بگذار.

signs.text_fa: این راه به جایی می‌رسد که پشتِ چاه است و در آن میوه می‌فروشند.
signs.tts_fa: این راه به جایی می‌رسد که پشتِ چاه است و در آن میوه می‌فروشند.

signs.text_fa: این راه به جایی می‌رسد که زنگ ندارد، ولی پر از کتاب است.
signs.tts_fa: این راه به جایی می‌رسد که زنگْ ندارد، ولی پُر از کتاب است.

signs.text_fa: این راه به جایی می‌رسد که زنگ دارد و بچه‌ها کتاب‌هایشان را آن‌جا می‌برند.
signs.tts_fa: این راه به جایی می‌رسد که زنگْ دارد و بچه‌ها کتاب‌هایشان را آن‌جا می‌برند.

signs.text_fa: این راه به وسطِ میدان می‌رسد؛ آن‌جا آب هست، ولی چیزی نمی‌فروشند.
signs.tts_fa: این راه به وسطِ میدان می‌رسد؛ آن‌جا آب هست، ولی چیزی نمی‌فروشند.

hints.animation: LUMI flies under the whole sentence on the reading card, right to left; each word glows in turn (card H1: pay attention to the whole sentence)
the key words of the sentence are highlighted on the reading card (card H2); trap words stay plain
two clues side by side (card H3): the highlighted key words on the card and a round lens with the matching clue of the scene (bell, fruit, books, bucket), joined by a dotted line to that place

reading.note: the listen button appears after the reading card has been on screen for 3 s, so the child tries to read first (card contract: audio must not replace reading); audio use is logged, it does not block mastery
reading.tts_rule: tts_fa = the exact TTS input, LIGHTLY marked (user decision, round 13: full vocalization made the voice worse): text_fa as written + kasra only for a spoken ezafe that is not written (کنارِ), «ـهٔ» for an ezafe after a silent ه, a word-final sukun only where the voice would otherwise add a false ezafe (کتابْ قرض), and a vowel only on known homographs (پُر، گُل). No fatha/damma/tashdid/sukun elsewhere. Stripped of the marks it equals text_fa.

misconceptions.description: Matches the place by one word the text shares with it; the rest of the sentence is ignored (card PERSIAN-01 misconception).
Chooses a place from the picture only, without reading: a wrong placement less than 1.5 s after the sign was picked up (FARSI_01 «انتخاب مکان صرفاً براساس تصویر»; team code).

mastery.note: card: mastery = a NEW text connected to the right place WITHOUT Highlight → the practice route markers (new texts) solved without H2 (highlight), H3 or Answer Assist; H1 (attend to the whole sentence) and audio are allowed. Levels 4-5 need the Transfer in the school (outside this room).

audio.on_place: wood knock into the ground + small confirm bell; the place reacts (bell ring, page flutter, fruit rustle, water splash)
audio.on_wrong: the sign wobbles and floats back, soft wood boop, never punishing
audio.on_solve: route markers chime in sequence + luma_motif_3_note_ascending
